chapter: Apollo Bar, Apollo managers and Harlem nightlife
title: The Nicholas Brothers and Sammy Davis's first Apollo date
summary: Whaley directed the show for the Nicholas Brothers in Philadelphia and arranged for Sammy Davis and the Will Mastin Trio.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: She's a superstar now. What about the Nicholas brothers when they were little babies.
See, I used to direct the band and play the piano, so I went over to Philadelphia to Lee Whipper --
The great movie start. One of our own, he just died not too long ago.
That's right, 100 and some years old. I was over there--

Yeah, and he told me hey, you direct the show and let Mrs. Nicholas play and her husband would play the drums. I said I'm not going to direct no show. This is when I first started, so sure enough I directed this show and let Mrs. Nicholas play the piano and her husband played the
drums and then the Nicholas brothers, oh, they were terrific. And did I tell you about Sammy Davis.
Sammy Davis came into the Apollo Theatre with his uncle and father and didn't have any music and I fixed their music and they used to get Sammy in the middle and squeeze him. I'll never forget that.
Yeah, Sammy Davis. I arranged for him and his father when they first come into the Apollo Theatre.
Was that the Will Mastin Trio.
Will Mastin Trio, yeah. I will never forget that.
What kind of act was that.
Oh, that was a dancing act. They used to dance. I don't remember much about it, see, because that was a long -- that was when I first went in the Apollo.
I just want to have it on the record that you were there in the beginning with all of these superstars, these black actors or superstars now.
